description: This Java source file defines a utility class 'Log' which provides static methods for logging messages at various levels (VERBOSE, DEBUG, INFO, WARN, ERROR, ASSERT). It acts as an adapter over Android's native 'android.util.Log' and manages a linked list of 'LogNode' instances to handle log dispatching. The class offers convenient methods for logging messages and throwables, enabling flexible and organized logging within an Android application.

classes.name: Log
classes.description: A helper class providing static methods for logging at various levels, acting as a wrapper over Android's 'android.util.Log' and managing a chain of 'LogNode' objects.

methods.description: Sets the LogNode chain to which log data will be sent.
